title: UneceTTExchangedDocument
description:
A collection of data for a piece of written, printed or electronic matter that is exchanged between two or more parties
for Track and Trace (TT) purposes.

description.description: The textual description of this TT exchanged document.

identifier.description: The identifier for this TT exchanged document.

issueDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value of the issuance of this TT exchanged document.

receiverSpecifiedParty.description: The receiving party specified for this TT exchanged document.

senderSpecifiedParty.description: The sending party specified for this TT exchanged document.

tTExchangedDocumentPurposeCode.description: The code specifying a purpose of this TT exchanged document.

tTExchangedDocumentStatusCode.description: The code specifying the status of this TT exchanged document.

tTExchangedDocumentTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of TT exchanged document.
